slides.title: Peace be upon him
slides.transcript: [warmly] Our Prophet. A book for Yusuf, peace be upon him. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] Eight small things, and all of them easy to copy.

slides.title: He Loved Children
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Loved Children. <break time="0.4s" /> He stopped for them in the street. He let them climb on his back. He never once told a child to go away. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Said Salam First
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Said Salam First. <break time="0.4s" /> To the old and the young, to people he knew and people he did not. He liked to be the one who said it first. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Smiled a Lot
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Smiled a Lot. <break time="0.4s" /> People said they had never met anyone who smiled more. A smile costs nothing, and it still counts as a good deed. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Was Gentle with Animals
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Was Gentle with Animals. <break time="0.4s" /> A cat could drink from the same water he was about to use, and he would let her finish, and say she was not dirty at all. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Loved Dates and Milk
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Loved Dates and Milk. <break time="0.4s" /> Plain food, and not very much of it. A few dates and a cup of milk, and he was glad. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Kept Everything Clean
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Kept Everything Clean. <break time="0.4s" /> Clean hands, clean clothes, clean teeth, clean water. He cleaned his teeth with a siwak — a soft green twig. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Fed Whoever Was Hungry
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Fed Whoever Was Hungry. <break time="0.4s" /> If there was food, it was shared. If there was little, it was shared more carefully. Nobody at his door was sent away empty. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: He Helped at Home
slides.transcript: [warmly] He Helped at Home. <break time="0.4s" /> He mended his own sandals. He swept. He sat with his family, and he was easy to live with. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Peace be upon him.

slides.title: And So We Say
slides.transcript: [softly] And So We Say. <break time="0.4s" /> Kind to children, kind to animals, kind to whoever was hungry. When we hear his name, we say one thing. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Peace be upon him. Goodnight, Yusuf.
